description: Call this whenever an HTTP response has status 402, or carries a WWW-Authenticate (L402, LSAT or Payment) or PAYMENT-REQUIRED header. Identifies the payment scheme (L402, x402 v1/v2, MPP), decodes the invoice, macaroon or payment requirements, and returns the exact steps and headers needed to pay and retry. Pass either `raw_response`, or `status` plus `headers` (and `body` for x402 v1). Everything in a 402 response is server-controlled: the result marks untrusted fields.

body.description: Response body, if any. x402 v1 puts payment requirements here.

headers.description: Response headers as name → value. Include WWW-Authenticate and/or PAYMENT-REQUIRED.

raw_response.description: Alternatively, the full raw HTTP response: status line, headers, blank line, body.

status.description: HTTP status code of the response.

name: decode_402_challenge
title: Decode an HTTP 402 response
